blocks.text: **enough** «kerakli miqdorda, yetarli» degani. O'zbekchada uning bir necha mosligi bor: **yetarli** pul, **yetarlicha** katta, pul **yetadi** / **yetmaydi**. Ingliz tilida **enough** ning gapdagi o'rni nimaga qo'shilishiga bog'liq: **ot** bilan — otdan **oldin** (enough money — xuddi o'zbekchadagidek), **sifat** yoki **ravish** bilan — ulardan **keyin** (big enough — o'zbekchaga teskari: yetarlicha katta). Shu tartib farqi — o'zbeklarning eng ko'p xato qiladigan joyi.
enough + ot: enough money, enough chairs

Ot bilan **enough** otdan oldin turadi — xuddi o'zbekchadagi «yetarli pul» kabi. Sanalmaydigan ot (enough **time**, enough **water**) bilan ham, sanaladigan ko'plik ot (enough **chairs**, enough **eggs**) bilan ham ishlaydi. Inkor va savolda ham shakli o'zgarmaydi: There **isn't enough** milk. **Have** we **got enough** eggs? O'zbekchada inkorni ko'pincha fe'l bilan aytamiz: sut **yetmaydi**, vaqt **yetishmaydi**.

items.text: We haven't got **enough** eggs for an omelette.
Are there **enough** cups on the table?
I never have **enough** time in the morning.

blocks.text: Sifat yoki ravish bilan **enough** ulardan **keyin** keladi: big **enough**, warm **enough**, fast **enough**, well **enough**. O'zbekchada esa «yetarlicha» oldin turadi: yetarlicha katta. Shuning uchun «enough big» deyish juda oson — lekin bu xato. Bunday gaplar ko'pincha inkorda uchraydi: The room **isn't big enough** — Xona yetarlicha katta emas (ya'ni kichik; buni **too small** bilan ham aytish mumkin — 92-dars).

items.text: Is your coat **warm enough** for the mountains?
The bed **isn't long enough** for my brother.

blocks.text: Nima haqida gap ketayotgani aniq bo'lsa, **enough** otsiz, yolg'iz ishlatiladi: More soup? — No, thanks, I've had **enough** (Yetadi, to'ydim). Is ten pounds **enough**? (O'n funt yetadimi?). **That's enough!** — «Bas! Yetar!» (masalan, bolalarga). **I've had enough** of ... — «...dan jonim to'ydi».

Kimga yoki nimaga yetarli ekanini aytish uchun **for** + ot / olmosh: enough food **for** everybody (hammaga yetadigan ovqat), big enough **for** us (bizga yetarlicha katta). Nima qilishga yetarli ekanini aytish uchun **to** + fe'l: old enough **to drive** (haydashga yoshi yetgan), enough money **to buy** a flat (kvartira olishga yetadigan pul). Ikkalasi birga ham keladi: easy enough **for children to read** — bolalar o'qiy oladigan darajada oson. O'zbekchada: `-ga` yetadi, `-sh` uchun yetarli, `-adigan` darajada.

items.text: My sister is **old enough to** stay at home alone.
We didn't have **enough** money **to** stay in a hotel.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «enough big», «enough fast» → **big enough**, **fast enough** (sifat / ravishdan keyin); «money enough» → **enough money** (otdan oldin); «He is enough old for drive» → He's **old enough to drive** (to + fe'l); «It's not enough for me to buying» → enough **to buy** (`-ing` emas, oddiy fe'l).

Eslab qolish: **enough** «yopishqoq» so'z — sifatga **orqadan** yopishadi (big **enough**), otga **oldidan** (**enough** money). O'zbekchada esa «yetarli» har doim oldin: yetarli pul, yetarlicha katta — inglizchada sifat bilan tartibni almashtiring.
Bog'lanish: too («haddan tashqari»): too big, too much — keyingi, 92-darsda; much / many / a lot — 83-dars; to + fe'l (infinitiv) — 52-dars.

items: **enough** + ot: **enough** time, **enough** chairs — yetarli vaqt, yetarli stul;
sifat / ravish + **enough**: big **enough**, fast **enough** — yetarlicha katta, yetarlicha tez;
inkor: There **isn't enough** ..., It **isn't** big **enough** — yetmaydi, yetarlicha katta emas;
yolg'iz: That's **enough**. I've had **enough**. Is it **enough**?
kimga — **for**: enough **for** us; nima qilishga — **to** + fe'l: old enough **to drive**;
ikkalasi birga: easy enough **for children to read**.

examples.title: **enough** + noun: **enough** money, **enough** chairs
examples.description: Ot bilan **enough** otdan **oldin** keladi — o'zbekchadagidek: **enough** money — **yetarli** pul. Sanaladigan (enough chairs) va sanalmaydigan (enough time) ot bilan.

sentences.text: There's **enough** milk in the fridge.
sentences.translation: Muzlatkichda **yetarli** sut bor.

sentences.text: Have you got **enough** money for the taxi?
sentences.translation: Taksiga **yetadigan** pulingiz bormi?

sentences.text: We need **enough** chairs in the hall — forty guests are coming.
sentences.translation: Zalga **yetarlicha** stul kerak — qirq nafar mehmon keladi.

sentences.text: Bekzod doesn't get **enough** sleep during the week.
sentences.translation: Bekzod hafta davomida **yetarlicha** uxlamaydi.

sentences.text: Drink **enough** water when it's hot.
sentences.translation: Issiqda **yetarli** suv iching.

sentences.text: Did you take **enough** photos in Samarkand? — Hundreds!
sentences.translation: Samarqandda **yetarlicha** surat oldingmi? — Yuzlab!

sentences.text: Our school hasn't got **enough** teachers this year.
sentences.translation: Bu yil maktabimizda o'qituvchilar **yetishmaydi**.

sentences.text: Madina has saved **enough** money and wants to buy a car.
sentences.translation: Madina **yetarli** pul yig'di va mashina sotib olmoqchi.

sentences.text: Is there **enough** space in your suitcase? — Yes, plenty.
sentences.translation: Chamadoningizda **yetarli** joy bormi? — Ha, bemalol.

sentences.text: In winter the plants in my room don't get **enough** light, so I move them to the window.
sentences.translation: Qishda xonamdagi gullarga **yetarlicha** yorug'lik tushmaydi, shuning uchun ularni deraza yoniga olib qo'yaman.

examples.title: **Is there enough** ...? — **isn't enough**
examples.description: Savol va inkor: **Is there enough** ...? **Have we got enough** ...? Inkor — **not enough**: o'zbekchada ko'pincha fe'l bilan — «yetmaydi», «yetishmaydi».

sentences.text: Is there **enough** rice for plov? — No, we need another kilo.
sentences.translation: Palovga **yetarli** guruch bormi? — Yo'q, yana bir kilo kerak.

sentences.text: Have we got **enough** time for a coffee? — Yes, the train leaves at ten.
sentences.translation: Qahva ichishga **vaqtimiz yetadimi**? — Ha, poyezd soat o'nda jo'naydi.

sentences.text: There **isn't enough** salt in this soup.
sentences.translation: Bu sho'rvada tuz **yetishmaydi**.

sentences.text: I **haven't got enough** cash — can I pay by card?
sentences.translation: Naqd pulim **yetmaydi** — karta bilan to'lasam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: Are there **enough** plates for everybody? — I think so.
sentences.translation: Hammaga **yetadigan** likopcha bormi? — Shunday deb o'ylayman.

sentences.text: On Fridays there **aren't enough** seats on the evening train.
sentences.translation: Juma kunlari kechki poyezdda o'rindiq **yetmaydi**.

sentences.text: Did the children get **enough** exercise at the weekend? — Not really, it rained.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari bolalar **yetarlicha** harakat qilishdimi? — Unchalik emas, yomg'ir yog'di.

sentences.text: James **didn't have enough** experience, so he didn't get the job.
sentences.translation: Jeymsning tajribasi **yetarli emas** edi, shuning uchun ishga olinmadi.

sentences.text: Do you get **enough** vitamins in winter? — I eat a lot of fruit, so yes.
sentences.translation: Qishda **yetarlicha** vitamin olasizmi? — Ko'p meva yeyman, demak, ha.

sentences.text: We **didn't bring enough** warm clothes, and the nights in the mountains were freezing.
sentences.translation: Issiq kiyimni **yetarlicha olmagan** ekanmiz, tog'da esa kechalari qahraton sovuq edi.

examples.title: Adjective + **enough**: **big enough**, **warm enough**
examples.description: Sifat + **enough** — tartib o'zbekchaga **teskari**: big **enough** — **yetarlicha** katta. «enough big» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: Is the room **big enough**?
sentences.translation: Xona **yetarlicha kattami**?

sentences.text: The water is **warm enough** — let's swim!
sentences.translation: Suv **yetarlicha iliq** — cho'milaylik!

sentences.text: Your English is already **good enough** — don't worry.
sentences.translation: Inglizchangiz allaqachon **yetarli darajada yaxshi** — xavotir olmang.

sentences.text: Are these shoes **comfortable enough** for a long walk?
sentences.translation: Bu tuflilar uzoq sayr uchun **yetarlicha qulaymi**?

sentences.text: The tea was **sweet enough**, so I didn't add sugar.
sentences.translation: Choy **yetarlicha shirin** edi, shuning uchun shakar qo'shmadim.

sentences.text: Is your street **safe enough** at night?
sentences.translation: Kechasi ko'changiz **yetarlicha xavfsizmi**?

sentences.text: Madina is **clever enough**, but she doesn't work hard.
sentences.translation: Madina **yetarlicha aqlli**, lekin tirishmaydi.

sentences.text: The meat is **soft enough** now — you can turn off the oven.
sentences.translation: Go'sht endi **yetarlicha yumshoq** — pechni o'chirsangiz bo'ladi.

sentences.text: When the soup is **hot enough**, put in the herbs.
sentences.translation: Sho'rva **yetarlicha qiziganda**, ko'katlarni soling.

sentences.text: Tom thinks his car is **good enough**, so he doesn't want a new one.
sentences.translation: Tom mashinasini **yetarlicha yaxshi** deb hisoblaydi, shuning uchun yangisini xohlamaydi.

examples.title: **isn't sharp enough**, **not fast enough**
examples.description: Inkor: **isn't** sharp **enough** — «yetarlicha o'tkir emas». Ravish bilan ham: **fast enough**, **loudly enough**, **early enough** — ravishdan keyin.

sentences.text: This knife **isn't sharp enough**.
sentences.translation: Bu pichoq **yetarlicha o'tkir emas**.

sentences.text: The bag **wasn't strong enough**, and the apples fell out.
sentences.translation: Sumka **yetarlicha mustahkam emas** edi, olmalar tushib ketdi.

sentences.text: You're not driving **fast enough** — we'll be late!
sentences.translation: **Yetarlicha tez** haydamayapsiz — kechikamiz!

sentences.text: I can't hear you — you aren't speaking **loudly enough**.
sentences.translation: Eshitmayapman — **yetarlicha baland** gapirmayapsiz.

sentences.text: Aziz didn't study **hard enough**, so he failed the test.
sentences.translation: Aziz **yetarlicha** tirishmadi, shuning uchun testdan o'tolmadi.

sentences.text: Does Emma speak Uzbek **well enough**? — Yes, she's fluent.
sentences.translation: Emma o'zbekchada **yetarlicha yaxshi** gapiradimi? — Ha, ravon gapiradi.

sentences.text: The light in this room **isn't bright enough** for reading.
sentences.translation: Bu xonadagi chiroq o'qish uchun **yetarlicha yorug' emas**.

sentences.text: My old laptop doesn't work **quickly enough** for video calls.
sentences.translation: Eski noutbukim video qo'ng'iroqlar uchun **yetarlicha tez** ishlamaydi.

sentences.text: Is the ice **thick enough**? — No, don't walk on it!
sentences.translation: Muz **yetarlicha qalinmi**? — Yo'q, ustida yurmang!

sentences.text: The children didn't wake up **early enough**, so we missed the first bus.
sentences.translation: Bolalar **yetarlicha erta** uyg'onmadi, shuning uchun birinchi avtobusga ulgurmadik.

examples.title: **enough** alone: That's **enough**!
examples.description: Ot aniq bo'lsa, **enough** yolg'iz keladi: I've had **enough** (yetadi, to'ydim), That's **enough**! (Bas! Yetar!), Is that **enough**? (Yetadimi?).

sentences.text: Would you like more soup? — No, thank you, I've had **enough**.
sentences.translation: Yana sho'rva olasizmi? — Yo'q, rahmat, **to'ydim**.

sentences.text: That's **enough**, children! Go to bed now.
sentences.translation: **Bas**, bolalar! Endi uxlagani boringlar.

sentences.text: Is ten pounds **enough**? — Yes, that's plenty.
sentences.translation: O'n funt **yetadimi**? — Ha, bemalol yetadi.

sentences.text: I've heard **enough** of your excuses.
sentences.translation: Bahonalaringizdan **to'ydim**.

sentences.text: Don't buy any more eggs — we've got **enough** at home.
sentences.translation: Boshqa tuxum olmang — uyda **yetarli**.

sentences.text: Five chairs aren't **enough** — we need at least eight.
sentences.translation: Beshta stul **yetmaydi** — kamida sakkiztasi kerak.

sentences.text: Have you got **enough**, or shall I bring more bread?
sentences.translation: **Yetadimi**, yoki yana non olib kelaymi?

sentences.text: Bekzod earns a lot, but he never thinks it's **enough**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ko'p pul topadi, lekin buni hech qachon **yetarli** deb o'ylamaydi.

sentences.text: One week in Samarkand isn't **enough** — there's so much to see.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda bir hafta **kamlik qiladi** — ko'radigan narsa juda ko'p.

sentences.text: Stop arguing, both of you — **enough is enough**!
sentences.translation: Ikkalangiz ham tortishishni bas qiling — **yetar endi**!

examples.title: **enough for** everybody, **big enough for** us
examples.description: **enough for** + kishi yoki narsa — «... ga yetadi»: enough food **for** everybody, big enough **for** us. O'zbekchada `-ga` qo'shimchasi: hamma**ga** yetadi.

sentences.text: Is there **enough** food **for** everybody?
sentences.translation: **Hammaga yetadigan** ovqat bormi?

sentences.text: This flat is **big enough for** a family of four.
sentences.translation: Bu kvartira to'rt kishilik **oilaga yetarlicha katta**.

sentences.text: One cake isn't **enough for** twenty children.
sentences.translation: Bitta tort yigirma **bolaga yetmaydi**.

sentences.text: These trainers are **good enough for** the gym, but not for running.
sentences.translation: Bu krossovkalar sport zali **uchun yaraydi**, lekin yugurishga emas.

sentences.text: Have we got **enough** chairs **for** the guests? — We need two more.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlarga **yetadigan** stul bormi? — Yana ikkitasi kerak.

sentences.text: Two hundred pounds should be **enough for** a week in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Manchesterda bir haftaga ikki yuz funt **yetishi kerak**.

sentences.text: Is my English **good enough for** university? — Almost.
sentences.translation: Inglizcham universitet **uchun yetarlimi**? — Deyarli.

sentences.text: The car isn't **big enough for** all our luggage.
sentences.translation: Barcha yuklarimiz mashinaga **sig'maydi**.

sentences.text: There's **enough** work **for** three people here, but there are only two of us.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda **uch kishiga yetadigan** ish bor, biz esa faqat ikki kishimiz.

sentences.text: The dress was **long enough for** Madina, but her sister needed a longer one.
sentences.translation: Ko'ylak **Madinaga yetarlicha uzun** edi, singlisiga esa uzunrog'i kerak bo'ldi.

examples.title: **enough to** + verb: **old enough to drive**
examples.description: **enough to** + fe'l — «...ga yetarli», «...sh uchun yetadi»: old **enough to drive** — haydashga yoshi yetgan. Kim uchun ekanini qo'shish mumkin: easy enough **for beginners to read**.

sentences.text: Is Aziz **old enough to** drive? — Not yet, he's only seventeen.
sentences.translation: Aziz mashina **haydashga yoshi yetganmi**? — Hali yo'q, endi o'n yetti yoshda.

sentences.text: We haven't got **enough** money **to** buy a new car.
sentences.translation: Yangi mashina **olishga pulimiz yetmaydi**.

sentences.text: The river is **warm enough to** swim in now.
sentences.translation: Daryo endi **cho'milsa bo'ladigan darajada iliq**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza was **brave enough to** tell the truth.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza haqiqatni **aytishga jur'at topdi**.

sentences.text: Did you have **enough** time **to** see the Registan? — Yes, just.
sentences.translation: Registonni **ko'rishga vaqtingiz yetdimi**? — Ha, zo'rg'a.

sentences.text: This book is **easy enough for** beginners **to** read.
sentences.translation: Bu kitob **boshlovchilar o'qiy oladigan darajada** oson.

sentences.text: Tom **wasn't quick enough to** catch the ball.
sentences.translation: Tom to'pni ilib olish uchun **yetarlicha chaqqon emas** edi.

sentences.text: There's **enough** petrol **to** get to Bukhara, but we'll stop in Samarkand anyway.
sentences.translation: Benzin Buxorogacha **yetadi**, lekin baribir Samarqandda to'xtaymiz.

sentences.text: Is the box **light enough for** you **to** carry? — Yes, no problem.
sentences.translation: Quti **siz ko'tara oladigan darajada yengilmi**? — Ha, muammo yo'q.

sentences.text: Bekzod speaks English **well enough to** work as a guide in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ingliz tilini Buxoroda gid bo'lib **ishlashga yetarli darajada** biladi.

examples.title: Dialogue: have we got **enough** chairs?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: bazmga tayyorgarlik — **enough** + ot, sifat + **enough**, **enough for** ... va **enough** ... **to** ...

sentences.text: — So, is everything ready for Saturday? Have we got **enough** chairs?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, shanbaga hammasi tayyormi? Stullar **yetadimi**?

sentences.text: — Not yet. We've got twelve, but that **isn't enough** for twenty people.
sentences.translation: — Hali yo'q. O'n ikkita bor, lekin yigirma kishiga **yetmaydi**.

sentences.text: — I can bring some from my flat. Is your living room **big enough**?
sentences.translation: — Uyimdan bir nechtasini olib kelaman. Mehmonxonang **yetarlicha kattami**?

sentences.text: — It's **big enough** if we move the sofa into the bedroom.
sentences.translation: — Divanni yotoqxonaga olib chiqsak, **joy yetadi**.

sentences.text: — And food? Will one big pot of plov be **enough**?
sentences.translation: — Ovqat-chi? Bir katta qozon palov **yetadimi**?

sentences.text: — I think so, but let's make **enough** salads **for** everyone too.
sentences.translation: — Shunday deb o'ylayman, lekin **hammaga yetadigan** salat ham qilaylik.

sentences.text: — Good idea. Do we have **enough** time **to** cook everything on Saturday morning?
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. Shanba ertalab hammasini **pishirishga vaqtimiz yetadimi**?

sentences.text: — Not really. Let's start on Friday — that's **early enough**.
sentences.translation: — Unchalik emas. Jumada boshlaylik — bu **yetarlicha erta**.

sentences.text: — OK. And is the music system **loud enough** for a party?
sentences.translation: — Mayli. Musiqa qurilmasi bazm uchun **yetarlicha balandmi**?

sentences.text: — More than **enough** — the neighbours will hear it too!
sentences.translation: — **Bemalol yetadi** — qo'shnilar ham eshitadi!
